method: Release builds. Identical pre-encoded bindings and JSON result decoding for JS and Wasm GC public string ABI. In-memory only: no storage, RPC, network or module compilation in timed regions. SQL checked against native SQLite, UPDATE side effects checked, exported SQLite integrity/rows checked by native SQLite, LTX also checked via the MoonBit decoder byte API; JS/Wasm identical bytes and round trip required before/after timing. Rotate engine order, 7 samples after 1000 SQL warmups / 3 checkpoint warmups. Idempotent UPDATE; LTX full snapshot with base64 input/output for both engines. No forced GC; one Node process and one headless Chromium page.

workload.schema: CREATE TABLE t(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,n INTEGER,title TEXT)

queries.name: point
queries.sql: SELECT id,n,title FROM t WHERE id=?

queries.name: scan
queries.sql: SELECT id,n,title FROM t ORDER BY id

queries.name: update
queries.sql: UPDATE t SET n=? WHERE id=?

check.name: point
check.sql: SELECT id,n,title FROM t WHERE id=?
